db:select.doc:name: Update stage
db:select.db:sql: WITH cur AS ( SELECT application_id, stage FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId FOR UPDATE ), upd AS ( UPDATE applications a SET stage = :toStage, stage_reason = :reason, updated_at = now() FROM cur WHERE a.application_id = cur.application_id AND (CAST(:expectedFrom AS text) IS NULL OR cur.stage = CAST(:expectedFrom AS text)) RETURNING a.application_id ), au AS ( INSERT INTO decision_audit (application_id, correlation_id, event, from_stage, to_stage, source_app, detail) SELECT upd.application_id, CAST(:correlationId AS uuid), :toStage, cur.stage, :toStage, :sourceApp, CAST(:detail AS jsonb) FROM upd JOIN cur ON cur.application_id = upd.application_id ), ob AS ( INSERT INTO outbox (id, queue_name, payload) SELECT CAST(:messageId AS uuid), CAST(:queue AS text), jsonb_build_object('messageId', CAST(:messageId AS text), 'correlationId', CAST(:correlationId AS text), 'applicationId', upd.application_id, 'type', CAST(:messageType AS text), 'attempt', 1, 'createdAt', CAST(:createdAt AS text)) FROM upd WHERE CAST(:queue AS text) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS found, (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS updated, (SELECT stage FROM cur) AS current_stage
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ applicationId: vars.applicationId, toStage: payload.toStage, reason: payload.reason, expectedFrom: payload.expectedFromStage, sourceApp: payload.sourceApp, correlationId: payload.correlationId, detail: write(payload.detail default {}, "application/json"), queue: payload.publish.queue, messageType: payload.publish."type", messageId: uuid(), createdAt: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"} }]

set-variable.value: #['Application is in stage ' ++ vars.result.current_stage ++ ', not the expected stage']
set-variable.doc:name: Set appErrorMessage

logger.message: #['stage change applicationId=' ++ vars.applicationId ++ ' from=' ++ vars.result.current_stage ++ ' to=' ++ vars.toStage ++ ' correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { applicationId: vars.applicationId, fromStage: vars.result.current_stage, toStage: vars.toStage }

db:select.doc:name: Resubmit application
db:select.db:sql: WITH cur AS ( SELECT application_id, stage FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId FOR UPDATE ), upd AS ( UPDATE applications a SET stage = 'VERIFYING', stage_reason = NULL, verification_round = a.verification_round + 1, updated_at = now() FROM cur WHERE a.application_id = cur.application_id AND cur.stage = 'DOCUMENTS_INCOMPLETE' RETURNING a.application_id, a.verification_round, a.correlation_id ), au AS ( INSERT INTO decision_audit (application_id, correlation_id, event, from_stage, to_stage, source_app) SELECT upd.application_id, upd.correlation_id, 'RESUBMITTED', 'DOCUMENTS_INCOMPLETE', 'VERIFYING', 'loan-system-api' FROM upd ), ob AS ( INSERT INTO outbox (id, queue_name, payload) SELECT CAST(:messageId AS uuid), 'loan.verify.q', jsonb_build_object('messageId', CAST(:messageId AS text), 'correlationId', CAST(upd.correlation_id AS text), 'applicationId', upd.application_id, 'type', 'VERIFY_REQUESTED', 'attempt', 1, 'createdAt', CAST(:createdAt AS text)) FROM upd ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS found, (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS updated, (SELECT stage FROM cur) AS current_stage, (SELECT verification_round FROM upd) AS verification_round

set-variable.value: #['Resubmission is only allowed from DOCUMENTS_INCOMPLETE (current stage: ' ++ vars.result.current_stage ++ ')']
set-variable.doc:name: Set appErrorMessage

logger.message: #['resubmitted applicationId=' ++ vars.applicationId ++ ' round=' ++ (vars.result.verification_round as String) ++ ' correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { applicationId: vars.applicationId, stage: "VERIFYING", verificationRound: vars.result.verification_round }
